title: Social FVM
tagline: Social FVM is a social project built on the Filecoin Virtual Machine network
description:
Social FVM is a social project built on the FVM network. Users can post, like, comment and interact with users on the project. Decentralized Social is critical for users to avoid censorship like we see often on platforms like Twitter/X and Meta(Facebook and Instagram). 
These platforms are forced by governments to block certain content. DeSoc users can see what they want to see
how_its_made:
Smart contracts are made with Solidity programming language, deployed using Remix IDE and deployed on the Filecoin Virtual Machine.
Frontend is done with React and Javascript however still incomplete and not included in submission
Main focus of submission is the solidity contracts.
